title: Find Sponsors for Your Channel
summary: Build a list of brands that already sponsor creators like you, then draft a pitch and a negotiation plan for each reply.

money_potential.label: Medium
money_potential.basis: Assumes you take or seek sponsors; the value is a shorter target list and faster replies.
money_potential.note: Value tiers are our rough estimates (labeled Estimate) of relative value to the business, each with its assumption. They are not promises, income claims or advice. Results depend on your market, offer and effort.

how_it_makes_money: A shorter list of brands that already pay for sponsorships.
Pitches and replies drafted, so you spend time on the deal.
who_its_for: Creators, athletes and newsletter writers who take sponsors.

stack.name: Sponsor Scout
stack.role: Finds brands already sponsoring creators in your space and drafts a pitch for each.
stack.creator: MichaelHeckert

stack.name: Sponsorship Negotiator
stack.role: Helps you prepare replies and terms when a brand answers.
stack.creator: AlexFinn

steps.name: Sponsor Scout
steps.does: Finds brands and drafts a pitch

outputs: A result you review before it is used

steps: Point Sponsor Scout at your public profile.
Pick the brands that fit your audience.
Edit and send each pitch yourself.
Use the negotiator when a brand replies.
guardrails: You press send yourself. Nothing goes out on its own.
Use only audience facts you can prove.
